findings.summary: The overflow note is a prose block that packs three separate behaviours into one paragraph, and its last sentence reads as contradicting the one before it.
findings.evidence: np.array([255], dtype=np.uint8) + 1 gives [0] silently. A scalar overflow warns instead, and in NumPy 1.x np.uint8(255)+1 is 256.
findings.fix: Split it into one-line bullets or a small table with columns Expression | NumPy 1.x | NumPy 2: array uint8 [255]+1 gives [0] with no warning; scalar uint8(255)+1 gives 256 in 1.x and warns and wraps to 0 in 2.x.
